name: agentpostage
description: Send PDFs as physical US mail with AgentPostage.

interface.shortDescription: Mail a PDF to a US address.
interface.longDescription: A mailing skill and standalone CLI for sending PDFs, checking prices and following letter status. Requires an AgentPostage key and prepaid funds for mailing.
defaultPrompt: Check the price to mail my PDF with AgentPostage.
Mail my PDF using the addresses I provided.
Check the status of my AgentPostage letters.
